info.title: Teams API
info.description: The Teams API provides programmatic access to manage team members, tenants, and environments for your Auth0 team.

servers.description: The base URL for Teams API

get.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of all team members
get.description: This endpoint retrieves a paginated list of all members under the current team. It supports checkpoint-based pagination for efficient retrieval of large datasets

post.summary: Create a tenant under the current team
post.description: This endpoint creates a new tenant under your team. Upon successful creation, the response includes the tenant's details and management client credentials. The tenant type (public or private) is determined by the attributes in the request payload. Refer to the payload schema for required attributes.

get.summary: List all tenants under the current team
get.description: This endpoint retrieves a paginated list of tenants for a specified team. It supports cursor-based pagination to ensure efficient data retrieval across large datasets. If the private cloud support beta is enabled for the team, the response includes both public and private tenants; otherwise, only public tenants are returned. To navigate results, the next cursor from the response should be used to fetch subsequent pages.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Filter tenants by environment. For public cloud tenants, use the short name (e.g., 'US-3', 'EU-1'). For private cloud tenants, use the space name (e.g., 'acme-dev').

parameters.name: locality
parameters.description: Filter tenants by locality. For public cloud tenants, matches locality (e.g., 'us', 'eu'). For private cloud tenants, matches the space's primary locality (e.g., 'virginia', 'frankfurt').

get.summary: Retrieve the list of host environments where a team's tenants exist
get.description: This endpoint retrieves a list of host environment identifiers (e.g. 'prod-us-3', 'acme-dev') where tenants associated with the team exist. These identifiers are intended only for use with the /api/v1/members/{member_id}/tenants/{environment} endpoint to list a team member's tenant access, and are not valid for other environment inputs such as the environment filter on /api/v1/tenants.

get.summary: Retrieve all metadata for a specific tenant, including domain, environment, locality, and creation date
get.description: This endpoint retrieves all metadata for a specific tenant, including the tenant's unique ID, name, domain, environment, locality, environment type, and creation date. It is useful for obtaining comprehensive information about a tenant for display in dashboards, auditing, or automated management tasks. The response includes all relevant fields required to identify and manage the tenant programmatically

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the tenant to retrieve (UUID format)

delete.summary: Delete a tenant from the current team
delete.description: Delete a tenant from the current team. Tenants tagged as Production cannot be deleted through this API. To protect a tenant from accidental deletion, tag it as Production via Tenant Settings. [Link](https://auth0.com/docs/get-started/tenant-settings#environment-tag).

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: The id of the tenant to delete

get.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of members for a specific tenant.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves a paginated list of all members for a specific tenant.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the tenant.

get.summary: Retrieve basic information for a specific team member
get.description: Returns the team member's identity and team-level role. Tenant access is retrieved via /api/v1/members/{member_id}/tenants/{environment}.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the team member to retrieve.

get.summary: List a member's tenant access within an environment
get.description: This endpoint retrieves a list of all tenants within a specific environment that the team member has access to. The host environment identifier required for this request can be obtained using the /api/v1/environments endpoint.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: Unique ID of the team member.

TenantId.description: The unique identifier of the tenant (UUID). This identifier is required for performing operations such as deleting the tenant. UUIDs ensure global uniqueness and are essential for managing tenant resources programmatically

EnvironmentTypeEnum.description:
Specifies the Environment tag for the tenant created in the Auth0 Public Cloud. It is used to distinguish between development, staging and production environments.
Development and Staging environments are intended for testing and pre-production use, while production is designated for live applications and subject to higher rate limits. Selecting the correct environment type ensures appropriate resource allocation and rate limits

TenantNamePrefix.description: The tenant name uniquely identifies a tenant programmatically and within various dashboards, such as Auth0 Dashboard. It can only contain alphanumeric characters, lowercase letters and "-".

TenantName.description: The tenant name uniquely identifies a tenant programmatically and within various dashboards, such as Auth0 Dashboard. It can only contain alphanumeric characters, lowercase letters and "-". However, it can't start nor end with "-". If not specified, a tenant name will be auto-generated.

Environment.description: The name of the cloud environment where the tenant was created

TenantFqdn.description: The fully qualified domain name of the tenant, which uniquely identifies its domain within the system. The domain is used to define the audience when interacting with the Management API, enabling programmatic management of the tenant’s configuration and resources.

Region.description: Locality in which the tenant was created

CreatedAt.description: The date and time when the tenant was created, formatted in ISO 8601 standard. This timestamp ensures consistency across time zones and systems

TenantItem.description: A tenant associated with your team

AdminEmail.description: The email of the person that will be added as an admin of the tenant. The person must be a member of the team.

PublicCloudRegion.description:
Specifies the Auth0 Public Cloud locality where the tenant will be created.
Available localities include United States (us), Europe (eu), Australia (au), Japan (jp), Canada (ca) and United Kingdom (uk).

PrivateCloudEnvironment.description: Specifies the name of the Auth0 Private Cloud environment where the tenant will be created.

ManagementClient.description: The Auth0 Management Client credentials required to authenticate and interact with the newly created tenant. These credentials allow authorized access to manage the tenant's configuration, resources, and API interactions.

client_name.description: The name of the Machine to Machine client, which is used for secure, automated interactions with the tenant's APIs and services.

client_id.description: The id of the Machine to Machine client, which is used for secure, automated interactions with the tenant's APIs and services.

client_secret.description: The client secret of the Machine to Machine client, which is used for secure, automated interactions with the tenant's APIs and services. This value is only returned when the tenant is created and cannot be retrieved later, so store it securely.

HostEnvironment.description: The name of the cloud environment where the tenant was created

environments.description: List of environments associated with the Team where tenants exist.

Sort.description: Sort order for results using MongoDB-style syntax. Defaults to 'created_at:-1' (newest first, descending). Use 'created_at:1' for oldest first (ascending). Format: field:direction where direction is 1 (ascending) or -1 (descending).
